d:
Almost all fitness routines work if we do them.
Because of this, we can:
1. Have smaller versions of our routine that we can do in ~10 minutes. This helps us stay consistent on off days so we keep building the habit.
2. Adjust our sleep and nutrition to try to have more energy.
3. Keep our routines progressive and adaptable (so they get harder as we get stronger). This progress keeps us motivated too.
